summary: Lunai Bioworks filed an 8-K announcing a 1-for-8 reverse stock split effective May 22, 2026. The split was authorized by stockholders on May 8, 2026, within a range of 1-for-3 to 1-for-30. No external advisor or premium is involved. The split adjusts the share count and CUSIP but does not alter fundamental value or trigger a corporate event such as a merger or tender. It appears routine to maintain Nasdaq listing compliance. There is no risk-arb angle or deal context; shareholders simply experience a mechanical reduction in shares outstanding.
